name: Seitokai Glory Hole
original_name: 生徒会グローリーホール
source: I am a member of the student council at this school and I work as a general affairs officer. One day, the student council president, Yuzusaki Aoi, who is also the chairman's granddaughter, confided in me that the school was facing financial difficulties and the chairman was in trouble. She was trying to find a way to help the chairman and came up with the idea of soliciting donations from parents by offering female students to provide entertainment. The idea was inspired by AV and involved providing fellatio services through glory holes in private rooms where the participants could remain anonymous and safe. The female student council members voted in favor and agreed to participate. The three female members who participated were the student council president, Yuzusaki Aoi, the vice president and my classmate, Kayamori Rino, and the treasurer, Omino Yuyuha. They explained the situation to me and asked me to take responsibility for the plan as the only male member. Although the idea of providing such services to parents was objectionable, I decided to accept the offer, as I couldn't let such a great opportunity go to someone else. And thus, the plan for the glory hole fellatio event, organized by the student council, began.
